name: Touma Kei
source: Takumi's father and violin maker. Takumi moved to Suno Village together when he was young. He has a bad leg and is poking his crutches. The parent-child relationship is jerky because he just stays in a workshop away from home and doesn't meet with Takumi very much.
translation: Takumi's father and violin maker. Takumi moved to Suno Village together when he was young. He has a bad leg and is poking his crutches. The parent-child relationship is jerky because he just stays in a workshop away from home and doesn't meet with Takumi very much.
